name: Turnly
title: Turnly · Your shifts at a glance
description: A free, open-source shift calendar for people who work shifts in Spain. No Pro, no ads, no account, and it works offline.
intro: A shift calendar for people who work shifts in Spain (healthcare, police, firefighters, industry, hospitality or any other sector): set up mornings, afternoons, nights, on-call shifts, post-night days and days off, and see your next shift at a glance.
features: Your next shift and your next day off on the today card; the month as a grid or list, the agenda and the year, with your phone calendar events next to your shifts. Notes with photos and tasks, and up to six calendars to see the days you are all off.

Tap or drag to paint several days, put more than one shift on the same day and undo whatever you want. The rotation wizard applies yours with a preview: rotating shifts, 24/72, 4×4, 6×4, 5×2, 2-2-3, “2 and 2”, “3 and 1” or your own pattern, starting from the day of the cycle you are on.

Alerts by shift type and note reminders, scheduled 30 days ahead. On Android, the shift alert rings like an alarm clock. On iPhone and iPad it is a time-sensitive notification that does not ring when Silent Mode is on; up to 60 alerts can be pending, and they are renewed when you open the app. On Android, there are also six widgets (today, week, month, agenda, two and four weeks) and “Silence the phone on my shifts”, which brings the sound back when they end.

Automatic backups you can check with “Test restore” and, on Android, one a day in the folder you choose (Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive…). Import LRHSoft Shifter backups, .ics, CSV or your phone calendar. With “Keep up to date”, your shifts go to your phone calendar; you can also save them as an .ics file.

Worked, night, public holiday and overtime hours against your goal and your hours bank, by month, quarter, year or any dates you like. Estimated gross and net pay with your hourly rate, your premiums and your withholding. PDF and CSV reports.

Vacation, personal days and leave balances per year, with carried-over days and when they expire. In the swap book you log the shifts you swap with colleagues, see who owes whom and apply them to the calendar.

Public holidays for Spain, with its regions and many municipalities, and for 40 more countries, all offline, plus your own. Make it yours: time and date format, currency, ten accent colors, ready-made palettes for your shifts and a calendar background image.
privacy_summary: Your shifts, notes and absences are stored only on your phone: there is no account, no server of ours and no analytics.

The app sends no data or crash reports to anyone. The only things that leave your phone are what you choose to export or send to your phone calendar, the daily copy in the folder you choose (on Android, if you turn it on), and the system backup: on Android, the one in your Google account, end-to-end encrypted with your screen lock (without a screen lock, Turnly stays out of it); on iPhone, the iCloud or computer backup.

faq.question: How much does it cost?
faq.answer: Nothing. Turnly is completely free and open source: no ads, no Pro tier and no in-app purchases. Not when you change phones either: there is nothing to buy again.

faq.question: Do I need an account or an internet connection?
faq.answer: No. There is no account and everything works offline, public holidays included.

faq.question: What about iPhone and iPad?
faq.answer: Yes: Turnly has been on the App Store since 10 November 2026, free, for iPhone with iOS 17 or later and, since 1.1.0, also for iPad with iPadOS 17 or later.

faq.question: How do I move Turnly to a new phone?
answer: The easiest way: on the old phone, open Settings › Backup and tap “Save a backup outside Turnly”. Save the .turnly file and take it to the new phone; there, install Turnly and open the file or tap “Import file”. You see what the backup contains and nothing is replaced until you confirm it.

Other ways, all of them free: when you set up a new Android, the direct transfer of apps and data by cable or Wi-Fi, or the Google backup (Android 9 or later, with backup turned on and a screen lock: PIN, pattern or password); on Android, also the automatic daily copy in the folder you choose, from which you import the latest one; on iPhone, the iCloud or computer backup.
Copies that only stay inside the app are lost if you uninstall it.

faq.question: What if I want to start over?
faq.answer: In Settings, “Delete everything and start over” deletes your calendars, notes, absences and settings (only the language is kept) and takes you back to the first run. First, it saves a backup you can restore or keep somewhere else.

chip: All free: no Pro, no ads and no account.
download_title: On the App Store for iPhone and iPad; Android, soon.
download_intro: Light and dark themes. Free, with no account.

download_notes.app_store: Free on the App Store, for iPhone and iPad with iOS 17 or later.

screenshots_intro: With made-up data, in light and dark.

screenshot_details.01-mes: Check your shifts for the month by color, code, and time. Today’s card shows when your next shift starts and when you have time off.
screenshot_details.02-lista: Switch to List to go through the same month day by day. You can see each shift’s name and code, full start and end times, and overtime.
screenshot_details.03-pintar: Pick a shift from the palette, then tap or drag across days to paint them. You can change a shift, add another, or undo your last stroke.
screenshot_details.04-rotaciones: Review the shifts, times, and length of each block in your cycle. You can add blocks before moving on.
screenshot_details.05-horas: See how many hours you’ve worked and have planned this month, including night and public holiday hours. You can also set an hours goal.
screenshot_details.06-festivos: Choose your country, region, and town to check each year’s public holidays. You can add a local holiday or import holidays from your phone’s calendar.
screenshot_details.08-vacaciones: Check how many days you have left, used, and planned. Review days carried over from last year and when they expire, or edit your balances.
screenshot_details.09-cambios: Log shift swaps with coworkers and check who owes shifts to whom. Each swap shows the shifts you give or receive and whether it is still pending.
screenshot_details.10-primer-uso: Choose how to start your schedule: import your shifts, use a rotation, or paint by hand. You can also restore a backup.
screenshot_details.11-widgets: Compare widgets showing your actual shifts and choose one for your Android home screen: today and tomorrow, an agenda, or several days.

features_title: Organize your shifts and track your hours and pay

feature_titles: Alarms, six widgets and do not disturb
